title: Social Video Link Collector and YouTube Channel Monitor
summary: Collects video links from Facebook messages and monitors YouTube channels, saving metadata to a sheet and emailing new finds.
headline: Track videos across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram
problem: Finding and logging content across platforms took manual effort.
solution: One workflow reads Facebook messages, extracts the link, identifies YouTube, TikTok or Instagram and saves its metadata. A second runs every three days, fetches new videos for a list of channels, stores their metadata and emails a summary of everything new.
role: Sole engineer. I built both workflows.
